This RMarkdown reports the data cleaning which included cleaning the fractures and cohort.The conditions below were met:

1. Had their 1st fx >= 01/04/2012 and <= 31/03/2018 when they were > 50 years old
2. Excluding fracture happening before the birth year.
3. Excluding records that happen outside of study period.
4. Excluding records that happen outside of observation period.
5. Excluding trauma fractures (same day as trauma codes or 3 distinct fracture sites on the same date.
6. Excluding fractures on the same day as death or after death.
